items.title: George Blanchin Interview, 1959-11-13
items.q: I know Monk was very friendly with the Boswells, so he probably knows that story better

ctx.x: Did you hear him on this side of the river or the other side? No, this side.

I didn't know this side. Well, I think Monk Caswell can give you the pitch on Hardy probably better than anyone because of his connection, well, not only with Hardy but with the Boswell sisters because, as I recall it, Emmett and one of the Boswell girls were pretty friendly. And I know Monk was very friendly with the Boswells, so he probably knows that story better, as well as good as anyone. Want to cut it off? Alright.
You want to talk about the midnight shows now?
